body:
Hey [name],

It's been way too long! I was thinking about you the other day when I drove past that taco place we used to go to, and I realized it's been like four months since we last talked. How have you been? Last I heard you were thinking about switching jobs, so I'm dying to know how that turned out.

Things here have been pretty busy but good. Work has been crazy lately, but I finally took a long weekend and went hiking, which I honestly needed more than I realized. I also started trying to cook more instead of ordering takeout every night, with mixed results. Let's just say the smoke alarm and I are on a first-name basis now.

We should catch up soon, either a phone call or a visit if you're up for it. Let me know what your schedule looks like in the next few weeks. I miss hanging out with you!

Talk soon,
[name]

Hey [name],

It's been way too long! I was thinking about you the other day when I walked past that terrible taco place we used to go to after class, and it made me laugh. How have you been? I feel like I've lost track of everything going on in your life.

Things here have been busy but good. Work has been keeping me on my toes, and I finally started cooking more at home instead of ordering takeout every night. Some of it has even been edible. I've also picked up running again, slowly, and mostly out of spite for how out of shape I got over the winter.

I'd love to hear what's new with you, and I'd really like to find a time to catch up properly, either a call or coffee if you're ever nearby. Let me know what your schedule looks like in the next few weeks.

Miss you, and talk soon!

[name]

Hi [name],

How have you been? It's been a few months since we last talked, so I wanted to write and see how you are doing. I hope you're not working too hard.

I'm doing okay, but work has been really busy these days, and I was so tired last month that I slept almost the whole weekend. The rainy season just ended here, and now it's so hot and humid that I feel exhausted all the time. To relax, I started going to a small pottery class on Saturday mornings. My cups still look strange, but it's fun, and I'm thinking of giving you one if it turns out well!

How about you? Are you still living in the same apartment, and how is your new job? I'd love to hear all about it. If you have time next month, let's have dinner or at least a video call. Please take care of yourself in this hot weather.

Talk soon,
[name]

Hey [name],

It's been way too long! I was thinking about you the other day when I walked past that terrible taco place we used to go to, and it made me laugh. How have you been? I feel like I've missed about three seasons of your life.

Things on my end have been pretty good, just busy. I've been trying to get back into cooking real meals instead of living on toast and cereal, with mixed results. I also finally started going for walks in the evenings, which has been surprisingly nice for clearing my head.

I'd love to hear what's new with you, whether it's big stuff or just the day-to-day. Want to set up a call or grab coffee sometime in the next couple of weeks? I'll be flexible, so just tell me what works.

Miss you, and hope you're doing well.

[name]

Hi [name],

How have you been? It's been a few months since we last talked, so I wanted to say hello. I'm doing okay, but work has been really busy lately and I've had almost no time to relax. Last month I finally took a short trip to the countryside with my family, and it was so nice to be away from the city for a while. The weather here is getting so hot and humid that I'm already tired of summer, haha. Also, I started going to a small yoga class on weekends, though I'm still not very flexible. How about you? I'd love to hear what's new in your life. If you have time, let's have a video call or meet for dinner sometime soon.

Take care,
[name]

Hey [name],

It's been way too long! I was thinking about you the other day when I walked past that little taco place we used to go to, and it made me realize how many months have slipped by since we last talked. Things have been busy on my end. Work has picked up a lot, and I've been trying to get back into running, though so far it's mostly me wheezing around the block and calling it progress. I also finally started learning to cook a few real meals instead of living on pasta and takeout, so that's a small win.

How are you doing? I want to hear everything, like how the new job is going and whether you ever took that trip you kept talking about. Let's set up a call or grab dinner sometime in the next couple of weeks. I'll even cook if you're brave enough.

Miss you, and talk soon!

[name]

〇〇さん

久しぶり!元気にしてる?しばらく連絡できなくてごめんね。

私はなんとか元気にやっています。春から仕事の担当が変わって、最近は慣れるのに必死でした。おかげで休みの日はほとんど家でごろごろしています。

最近は少し余裕が出てきたので、前から気になっていた料理を始めてみました。まだ失敗も多いけど、先週つくったカレーはけっこう上手にできたよ。

〇〇さんは最近どう?仕事や家のことで変わったことがあったら、ぜひ聞かせてほしいです。

落ち着いたら、また久しぶりにごはんでも行こうよ。都合のいい日があったら教えてね。

それじゃあ、無理しすぎないようにね。返事待ってます!

〇〇より

Hi [name],

It's been a while! How have you been? I was thinking about you the other day when I found the photo we took at that ramen shop, so I decided to write.

I'm doing fine, but work has been really busy since spring, and I often come home too tired to do anything. Last month I finally took a few days off and went to a hot spring with my family. It was so relaxing, and I realized I had been working too much.

It has become really hot here lately, and I'm already tired of the humidity. How is the weather where you are?

I would love to hear what is going on in your life. Are you still going to that yoga class? If you have time, let's have a video call sometime this month. Please take care of yourself, and don't work too hard!

Talk soon,
[name]

I want to hear everything, including whether you ever finished that big project you were stressing about last time.

On my end, things have been busy but good. Work has kept me running, and I've been trying to get back into cooking on the weekends, with mixed results. Last week I attempted homemade pasta and ended up with something closer to glue, but it was fun anyway. I've also been walking more in the evenings, which has helped me feel a bit more human.

Let's find a time to catch up properly, whether that's a phone call or a video chat. I miss our long, rambling conversations. Write back when you get a chance and let me know what your schedule looks like.

Talk soon,
[name]

By the way, are you still playing tennis? I remember you said you wanted to join a tournament. I started jogging in the morning, but I'm not sure how long I can keep it up (haha).

If you have time, let's have dinner or a video call sometime. I'd love to hear what's new with you. Please take care of yourself!

Your friend,

〇〇さんへ

久しぶり!しばらく連絡できなくてごめんね。元気にしてる?

私は相変わらず仕事に追われているけど、先月からヨガ教室に通い始めて、少しずつ生活のリズムが整ってきた気がするよ。運動不足だった体が、ようやく目を覚ましてきた感じ。

それから、この前の連休に久しぶりに実家へ帰って、家族とのんびり過ごしてきたんだ。母の手料理がやっぱり一番だなって、しみじみ思った。

〇〇さんは最近どうしてる?仕事や新しい生活には慣れたかな。

落ち着いたら、また一緒にごはんでも食べに行こうよ。近況を聞けるのを楽しみにしてるね。

また連絡します!

〇〇さん

休みの日は、前から気になってた料理を少しずつ試してて、先週はカレーをスパイスから作ってみたよ。思ったよりおいしくできて、ちょっと自信がついた(笑)

〇〇さんは最近どう?仕事とか、体調とか、変わりないかな。

落ち着いたら、ひさしぶりにゆっくりごはんでも行こうよ。近いうちに日程を相談させてね。

返事はいつでもいいから、また近況を聞かせてください。
